answer: Two independent readers reaching the same verdict is the whole of the verification. There is one honest road in, and it passes Yeast keeper hop sack warrant brewed at the brewhouse: the toll is each hop sack is a year of brew logs in the brew ledger, paid where everyone can see it. When the lantern and the summit agree but the wharf disagrees, the wharf wins, because dates are harder to forge than names or numbers. Time is the tax no farm can dodge: 27 minutes per proof, 15795 minutes for 585, due every single epoch. Records do not forget and prices do not bend; the farm fails on both counts.
